notes.title: Update notes for Patch 1.2 December 10th 2024
notes.notes:
Improved tutorial
 Changed the mesh of the ammunition box in the tutorial
 Improved poison interface
 Added a vignette effect when inside tall grass
 Fixed the telescope interface
 Added a dummy for practice
 Gavern's roulette with mouse: no need to press the button; you can click directly on the screen
 Changed the color of the active teleport point
 Updated descriptions of some items
 Removed tutorial signs
 In the main menu, "Continue" appears above "New Game"
 The interaction button disappears from the spherical circle when used, not when leaving
 If your inventory is full of a resource, the interaction button appears red above the resource
 The cursor is no longer visible when using teleportation
 Improved main menu
 Teleport between zone 2 and the area now activates depending on where the player comes from
 The player can no longer fall into the water near the waterfall

notes.title: Update notes for Patch 1.1 November 13th 2024
notes.notes:
The crash related to Wine or Jam  has been fixed.
 Now, the inventory indicates the number of extra dishes you have.
 The boil resource has been moved slightly next to the boil totem.
 The cheese has been moved next to the third-to-last statue.
 A jam resource in the combat area has been moved from behind a rock to make it a bit more visible.
 Loading screen text has been added.
 A collider has been added to prevent climbing onto one of the rocks in the hallway after the first combat area past the boil totem.
 When you open the totems, the game saves, and an interface appears.
 Discovered dish animation: now, when you have a full inventory of extra dishes and the dish is extra.
 Statue dish text is no longer dark, and the dish image is better positioned.
 The potion icon for Gavern in the HUD is aligned with the hearts; it’s closer to the red hearts if you don't have a shield (gold hearts).
 Corrections to various improvement animations.
 Changes to the animation for a newly discovered dish.
 Each time you make a dish, you are notified of its type—real, resident, extra, or statue.
 In QTE, the HUD commands no longer disappear.
 A jam resource was moved from the starting area.
 The ammunition box in the tutorial was moved.
 The square button no longer appears when you only have cheese.
